item.alone_adventure.crystalline_heart.t: A heart condensed from crystal; the crystals on it still shift in color.
After taking damage, regenerate 1 shield every 10 seconds
Higher armor and armor toughness increase shield cap and recovery speed
item.alone_adventure.bleedingshield.tool: A shield condensed from blood; the blood still tries to erode its wielder.
Reduces max health by 20%, but grants +30% armor bonus
item.alone_adventure.adaptive_flesh.tool: A piece of constantly writhing living tissue, seemingly learning alongside your pain.
Taking a type of damage grants 1 stack of Adaptation (15% reduction per stack, max 5 stacks); when taking other damage types, each existing stack decays by 1
item.alone_adventure.night_contract.tool: A contract signed in blood. Moonlight is its gift, sunlight its curse.
In sunlight (daytime with no cover overhead): cannot regenerate health and suffers Wither continuously
At night (with or without cover): regenerate 1 health every 4 seconds and gain Night Vision
Can sleep during the day; sleeping during the day skips directly to nightfall that day
The brighter the moon phase, the higher the bonus: New Moon +10%, Full Moon up to +50% movement speed and critical damage
Current moon phase: %1$s -- Movement Speed, Critical Damage +%2$s
A necromantic contract signed in blood, turning your attacks into seeds of calamity.
Gain 10 absorption hearts every 60 seconds (does not stack)
On attack, apply Calamity I for duration = attack damage × 0.8 seconds; multiple attacks stack duration
Active skill (default key R): Nearby creatures' Calamity duration becomes 1/5, level +3; next attack duration ×2
When Calamity level × Calamity duration (seconds) ≥ target's health, the next attack deals 32676 direct damage
item.alone_adventure.broken_mask.tooltip: A cracked stone mask, whispering of forgotten contracts.
On hit, 20% chance to apply Vulnerability I to the target (10 seconds)
When the target's Vulnerability is consumed by damage: 50% chance to gain Strength I (5 seconds) and restore 10 health
Base attributes: +7 Armor, +20% Max Health, +3 Armor Toughness
Active skill (default key R): all entities within an 8-block radius gain Vulnerability II (1 minute); self restores half of max health and gains Resistance II (1 minute), cooldown 90 seconds
item.alone_adventure.binding_bandage.too: Old bandages soaked in herbs. The tighter they are wrapped, the less willing one is to fall.
On hit, 50% chance to apply Endurance I to yourself (3 seconds: Speed, Jump Boost, no hunger consumption), does not stack
Attacks against targets with Weakness deal extra damage equal to Weakness level ×2
Active skill (default key R): gain 1 shield point (max 3), cooldown 45 seconds; when damaged, shield absorbs damage and loses 1 point
item.alone_adventure.survival_whimper.to: A whimper that refuses to die, using your last breath to make you stand again.
After immunity, teleport back to your respawn point (or world spawn if no bed)
item.alone_adventure.dragon_power.toolti: The blessing of the Sakura Dragon, an undying power flowing through your body like dew.
Immune to lethal damage, revive in place with full health
After revival: Invisibility 7 seconds, Invulnerability 5 seconds, Darkness 3 seconds
item.alone_adventure.parryshield.tooltip: Raise this shield at the instant before an enemy's attack lands to achieve a perfect defense.
Block an attack within 1 second of raising the shield: completely immune, reflect 250% damage, and inflict Weakness on the attacker for 3 seconds (shield parry cooldown 1 second)
Holding the shield for a long time: absorbs 80% of damage
A mysterious imperial weapon from 39 millennia in the future, its blade driven by highly compressed energy; its strikes far exceed ordinary alloys.

Armor Piercing: primary attacks ignore armor toughness; against enemies with armor above 8, deal 0.3 extra damage per point above, and 0.5 extra damage per point of toughness above 6 (up to 10 total). This damage ignores armor and armor toughness

Overclock: right-click to activate (lasts 13 seconds by default, costs 5 durability). While active, gain Resistance II for 5 seconds, attack damage +50%, hits deal an extra 3 fire damage and ignite for 4 seconds, and 60% of damage dealt is converted into healing for yourself; cooldown 30 seconds after use (duration and cooldown configurable)
item.alone_adventure.chainsawsword.toolt: A mysterious imperial weapon from 39 millennia in the future, using serrated teeth to cut down enemies.

Tear: normal attacks stack 4 layers; sweep hits have a 50% chance to stack 2 layers (refreshes duration on hit). When the duration ends, deal damage once (level × 0.6), then halve the level; after halving, it automatically reapplies and continues resolving until the level reaches zero.

Sweep: right-click to activate (lasts 7 seconds, costs 3 durability, cooldown 15 seconds). While active, every 0.2 seconds deal 1 damage to entities in a 6-block cone in front (line of sight blocked by blocks), with a 50% chance to apply 2 layers of Tear. Sweep damage ignores all armor and armor toughness.
item.alone_adventure.painstrike_hammer.t: A brutal heavy hammer; every swing punishes a group of enemies and breaks down their defenses.
Area Strike: enemies within 2 blocks of the hit point take 60% attack damage and also gain Vulnerability (does not harm allies or tamed animals)
Vulnerability: each hit (including area hits) stacks 2 layers of Vulnerability
item.alone_adventure.ink_blade.tooltip.d: Ink condensed into a blade; thrown, it scatters, then slowly returns from the void.
item.alone_adventure.ink_blade.tooltip.t: Right-click to throw a flying blade: deals 3 damage and applies Weakness (+1 level per hit, max 5 levels, lasts 5 seconds), throw cooldown 0.15 seconds
item.alone_adventure.ink_blade.tooltip.d: The blade is condensed from ink and never breaks: each thrown blade costs 1 durability, and while idle recovers 1 point every 0.5 seconds (2 per second)
item.alone_adventure.shock_device.toolti: A portable electric discharge device. Once thrown, it bursts with arcs, shocking all who come near.
Right-click to throw (trajectory like a snowball): begins discharging in flight, and after hitting, stays in place and continues discharging for 5 seconds; throw cooldown 0.5 seconds
Shock: every 0.2 seconds deal 0.5 damage to all creatures within a 4-block radius (does not harm the thrower, no knockback), hits apply Slowness I (1.5 seconds), up to 25 total damage
item.alone_adventure.regiment_banner.too: A battle flag carrying the honor of a regiment. Plant it, and soldiers have a reason not to retreat.
Right-click to plant the flag in place (lasts 30 seconds): players within an 8-block radius gain Resistance II and Endurance I; planting cooldown 120 seconds
The first time a player enters the banner's range, they are topped up to 10 absorption hearts (each banner affects each player only once)
8 durability uses, destroyed when depleted; can be repaired in an anvil with gold ingots (each ingot restores 2 points); does not stack, cannot be enchanted
item.alone_adventure.sealed_throne.toolt: A throne congealed from starlight. The wearer gradually draws in its light.
Starlight regenerates 1 point every 5 seconds, max 12 points
Starlight recovery: +1 point every 5 seconds (100 ticks)
Each Starlight grants +5% attack damage; every 4 Starlight grants +2 armor
When hit and losing red hearts, lose 2 Starlight (shield-absorbed damage does not cause loss)
Active skill (default key R): consume all Starlight; every 6 Starlight grants 1 shield point (max 4) and an equal amount of absorption hearts (20 seconds)
item.alone_adventure.charging_core.toolt: A core that cycles energy between different forms. The longer it charges, the stronger the release when switching.
Thunder Form: max 6 layers, each layer charges for 10 seconds; attacks deal extra damage equal to layers ×5%; switch release: Strength (layers +1) for 15 seconds
Frost Form: max 10 layers, each layer charges for 15 seconds; gain armor equal to layers and armor toughness equal to layers/2; switch release: absorption hearts equal to layers (1:1 stacking)
Dark Form: max 5 layers, each layer charges for 30 seconds; no effect normally; switch release: next attack deals extra damage equal to layers ×8
Active skill (default key R): switch to the next form and release the current form's charge, cooldown 5 seconds
item.alone_adventure.hunter_serum.toolti: A cloudy serum injected with predator instinct. When activated, the world fades to black and white, and prey has nowhere to hide.
Passive: when using injections, the potion effect level gained is +1, and the duration can stack with existing effects of the same type

Active skill (default key R): Hunter's Vision—your view becomes black and white, highlighting creatures (red), drops (blue), and containers (yellow) within range (visible through walls, only to you). During this time, attacks ignore 40% armor and 20% armor toughness. Lasts 15 seconds, cooldown 60 seconds
item.alone_adventure.quest_contract.tool: A contract trinket that records the wearer's trials—active while worn, and can be used as a crafting material after all quests are completed. Right-click with materials in the offhand to submit progress.
tooltip.alone_adventure.quest.material_r: ✔ Contract complete—can now be used as a crafting material
tooltip.alone_adventure.quest.material_l: ✘ Complete all quests before it can be used as a crafting material
message.alone_adventure.quest.all_done: Contract complete! This item can now be used as a crafting material
tooltip.alone_adventure.golden_beetroot: Eating grants Endurance I for 60 seconds; can also be used to brew Potion of Endurance
tooltip.alone_adventure.sailor_spinach: Eating restores 4 hunger and 8 saturation, and grants Strength II (30 seconds) and Regeneration II (10 seconds)
item.alone_adventure.injection_empty.too: An empty syringe used to craft potion injections
tooltip.alone_adventure.injection_templa: This injection has no effect (place a potion in the crafting table first)
item.alone_adventure.monster_ash.tooltip: Ash left after killing hostile creatures (unaffected by Looting; higher chance when wearing Hunter Serum)
item.alone_adventure.blood_shard.tooltip: Blood overflowing after killing hostile creatures (unaffected by Looting; higher chance when wearing Hunter Serum)
item.alone_adventure.first_aid_kit.toolt: On use, immediately restore 60% of max health, cooldown 120 seconds (3 durability uses total; does not stack, cannot be enchanted)
item.alone_adventure.eerie_music_box.too: A tireless music box. The melody is beautiful, the price is expensive.
Right-click to use: immediately gain 90 shield points, offsetting final damage 1:1, lasting until depleted or death
Curse: after 60 seconds the melody stops and you die immediately—Totems of Undying, shields, and lethal damage immunity trinkets cannot save you, and relogging cannot escape it
gui.alone_adventure.eerie_music_box.used: The eerie melody begins to turn...
gui.alone_adventure.eerie_music_box.warn: §cThe music box's melody is about to stop...
gui.alone_adventure.eerie_music_box.bar: Music Box Shield: %s points | Life will be taken in %s seconds
item.alone_adventure.gun.tooltip.usage: Left-click to fire / Right-click to aim (spread halved) / R or sneak-right-click to reload / G to switch ammo
item.alone_adventure.gun.tooltip.dual: When dual-wielding guns, hold left-click to alternate fire (fire rate is calculated independently for each gun)
gun.alone_adventure.stat.line4: Penetration %s | Ricochet %s | Knockback %s | Effective Range %s blocks | Aim %s×
gun.alone_adventure.stat.ammo_types: Ammo Switch: %s (%s types total, press G to cycle)
item.alone_adventure.imperial_eagle.tool: The double-headed eagle emblem of the human Imperium, symbolizing glory and immortality.
Negative effect inversion: Weakness→Strength, Slowness→Speed, Darkness→Night Vision, Poison→Regeneration
Immune to fire and lava damage
Active skill (default key R): Resistance II, Strength I, Regeneration II for 2 minutes, cooldown 30 seconds
item.alone_adventure.starlight_greatswor: A heavy sword whose blade flows with starlight. The longer it is held, the brighter it shines.
Charge: while held, gain 1 layer of Starlight Charge every 3 seconds (max 20 layers)
On hit: base damage 15, +10% per layer, and gain absorption equal to the layers (yellow hearts, stacks once every 3 seconds), then charge resets to zero
item.alone_adventure.reaper_scythe.toolt: A giant scythe. Each new creature killed grants extra damage.
item.alone_adventure.machine_claw.toolti: A robotic component made with ancient technology. Its strikes are extremely fast; the deeper the combo, the fiercer the tear.
Combo: base damage 3; each hit on an entity makes subsequent attacks +1 damage; if no hit (including missed swings) within 2 seconds, the bonus resets to zero
item.alone_adventure.ham_club.tooltip.de: A whole dried ham. Fight while eating; the more you fight, the fuller you get.
item.alone_adventure.ham_club.tooltip.fo: Each attack restores 3 hunger; when durability (32) is depleted, it turns into a bone in place
item.alone_adventure.valkyrie_helmet.too: A leather helmet painted with wings, as if a Valkyrie whispers in your ear.
Leather helmet defense +2 (3 points total); while worn, damage dealt +10%
item.alone_adventure.resurrection_contra: A contract trinket that trades Evoker power for a pact of resurrection—active while worn, and can be used as a crafting material after all quests are completed. Right-click with materials in the offhand to submit progress.
tooltip.alone_adventure.quest.material_r: ✔ Contract complete—can now be used as a crafting material
tooltip.alone_adventure.quest.material_l: ✘ Complete all quests before it can be used as a crafting material
message.alone_adventure.quest.all_done: Contract complete! This item can now be used as a crafting material
item.alone_adventure.monster_ash.tooltip: Add when mixing two injections to increase the potion level, at the cost of reducing the duration
item.alone_adventure.blood_shard.tooltip: Add when mixing two injections to increase the potion's duration
tooltip.alone_adventure.injection_empty: An empty syringe used to craft potion injections
Mix one potion with 2 empty syringes and 1 Monster Ash to craft an injection
